# scamp_storage_class (Data Source)

Find a storage class by name (e.g., 'SSD', 'HDD').



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the storage class to search for.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description of the storage class.
- `free_size_gb` (Number) Root-disk allowance included with a VM at no charge (0 = none).
- `id` (Number) ID of the storage class.
- `max_size_gb` (Number) Maximum disk size in GB.
- `min_size_gb` (Number) Smallest volume this class accepts. Classes differ (25, 50, 100, 250 GB), and a smaller size is rejected on apply.
- `price_per_gb_hour_millicents` (Number) Price per GB per hour in millicents.
- `read_bandwidth_limit` (Number) Read bandwidth limit in MB/s.
- `read_iops_limit` (Number) Read IOPS limit.
- `replica_count` (Number) Number of data replicas.
- `write_bandwidth_limit` (Number) Write bandwidth limit in MB/s.
- `write_iops_limit` (Number) Write IOPS limit.
